task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate the robot CAR to the CUP, pick it up, navigate to the TABLE, and place the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: The robot CAR has a manipulator and is able to grasp the CUP.
The locations of the CUP and TABLE are accessible.
Navigating directly to the coordinates of the CUP and TABLE places the robot within its 2.0 interaction distance.
rtdl: def task PickAndPlaceTask(;){ state nav1_success: bool; state nav1_msg: string; state pick_success: bool; state pick_msg: string; state nav2_success: bool; state nav2_msg: string; state place_success: bool; state place_msg: string; sequence{ do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav1_success, message->nav1_msg); check(nav1_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP"; success->pick_success, message->pick_msg); check(pick_success == true); do NavTo(robot_name="CAR", x=-2.0, y=2.0, tolerance=0.5; success->nav2_success, message->nav2_msg); check(nav2_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR", object_name="CUP", location_name="TABLE"; success->place_success, message->place_msg); check(place_success == true); } }
